ui-color-scheme.$description: The color scheme in force: `light`, or `dark` under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`. In print it is `light`, also under `.ui-dark`. `html` reads it as its `color-scheme`, `.ui-light` and `.ui-dark` set it on a part of the page, and `Typography` reads it in a style query. Set the classes, not the token.

ui-palette-chroma.$description: Chroma of the palette source color, as a multiplier of `0.21`.

ui-palette-hue.$description: Hue of the palette source color in degrees. `222.8` (blue) by default, in both color schemes.

ui-palette-hue-rotate-by.$description: Hue drift per palette step in degrees: each step rotates one more time than the last, so `1` spreads 15° across the ramp. `.ui-critical`, `.ui-info`, `.ui-success` and `.ui-warning` use `1` for livelier tints; `.ui-neutral` and the brand palette `0`.

ui-palette-source.$description: The source color the palette is derived from. A theme leaves it unset, and `palette.css` builds it from `--ui-palette-hue` and `--ui-palette-chroma`: `oklch(58% 0.105 222.8)` by default. Set it to replace those two primitives. Any color works: the palette keeps its oklch hue, scales its chroma and sets the lightness per step. See [Palette](/guide/theming#palette).

ui-gray-chroma.$description: Chroma of the gray ramp. Raise it for tinted grays.

ui-color-1.$description: Step 1 of the palette, at 98% lightness.
ui-color-1.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 98% calc(0.03 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (0 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-2.$description: Step 2 of the palette, at 97% lightness.
ui-color-2.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 97% calc(0.06 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (1 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-3.$description: Step 3 of the palette, at 93% lightness.
ui-color-3.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 93% calc(0.1 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (2 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-4.$description: Step 4 of the palette, at 84% lightness.
ui-color-4.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 84% calc(0.12 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (3 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-5.$description: Step 5 of the palette, at 80% lightness.
ui-color-5.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 80% calc(0.16 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (4 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-6.$description: Step 6 of the palette, at 71% lightness.
ui-color-6.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 71% calc(0.19 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (5 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-7.$description: Step 7 of the palette, at 66% lightness.
ui-color-7.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 66% calc(0.2 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (6 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-8.$description: Step 8 of the palette, at 58% lightness.
ui-color-8.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 58% calc(0.21 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (7 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-9.$description: Step 9 of the palette, at 53% lightness.
ui-color-9.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 53% calc(0.2 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (8 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-10.$description: Step 10 of the palette, at 49% lightness.
ui-color-10.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 49% calc(0.19 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (9 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-11.$description: Step 11 of the palette, at 42% lightness.
ui-color-11.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 42% calc(0.17 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (10 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-12.$description: Step 12 of the palette, at 35% lightness.
ui-color-12.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 35% calc(0.15 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (11 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-13.$description: Step 13 of the palette, at 27% lightness.
ui-color-13.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 27% calc(0.12 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (12 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-14.$description: Step 14 of the palette, at 20% lightness.
ui-color-14.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 20% calc(0.09 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (13 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-15.$description: Step 15 of the palette, at 16% lightness.
ui-color-15.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 16% calc(0.07 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (14 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-16.$description: Step 16 of the palette, at 10% lightness.
ui-color-16.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 10% calc(0.05 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (15 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-gray-1.$description: Step 1 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-1` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-1.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-1) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-2.$description: Step 2 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-2` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-2.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-2) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-3.$description: Step 3 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-3` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-3.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-3) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-4.$description: Step 4 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-4` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-4.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-4) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-5.$description: Step 5 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-5` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-5.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-5) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-6.$description: Step 6 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-6` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-6.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-6) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-7.$description: Step 7 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-7` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-7.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-7) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-8.$description: Step 8 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-8` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-8.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-8) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-9.$description: Step 9 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-9` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-9.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-9) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-10.$description: Step 10 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-10` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-10.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-10) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-11.$description: Step 11 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-11` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-11.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-11) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-12.$description: Step 12 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-12` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-12.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-12) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-13.$description: Step 13 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-13` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-13.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-13) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-14.$description: Step 14 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-14` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-14.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-14) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-15.$description: Step 15 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-15` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-15.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-15) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-16.$description: Step 16 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-16` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-16.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-16) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-palette-accent.$description: The accent shade of the current palette: `Callout` icons and outlined borders. Stronger with more contrast. The severity `Chip` dot reads it. Re-derived inside every severity scope, so `.ui-success` gets a green one.
ui-palette-accent.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-color-9) min(l, var(--_ui-accent-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-color-7) max(l, var(--_ui-palette-accent-min-lightness)) c h ) )

ui-palette-border.$description: The border shade of the current palette: tonal `Callout` borders. Stronger with more contrast. Severity `Chip` borders read it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-border.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-color-5) min(l, var(--_ui-palette-border-max-lightness)) c h ), oklch( from var(--ui-color-11) max(l, var(--_ui-palette-border-min-lightness)) c h ) )

ui-palette-strong.$description: The strongest shade of the current palette, the darkest in light mode and the lightest in dark mode, with the most contrast against the page: `Callout` text, the default `Button` fill when `--ui-button-accent` is unset. Severity `Chip` text reads it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-text.$description: A readable text shade of the current palette, light enough in dark mode to read as text. Darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-text.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-color-11) min(l, var(--_ui-palette-text-max-lightness)) c h ), oklch( from var(--ui-color-6) max(l, var(--_ui-palette-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-accent-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-palette-tonal.$description: The tonal fill of the current palette: primary and critical tonal buttons when `--ui-primary-tonal` is unset. Stronger with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-tonal.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-color-6) max(l, var(--_ui-palette-tonal-min-lightness)) c h ), oklch( from var(--ui-color-11) min(l, var(--_ui-palette-tonal-max-lightness)) c h ) )

ui-palette-tonal-subtle.$description: A faint fill of the current palette: tonal severity `Callout`s. Tonal severity `Chip`s read it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-tonal-subtle.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-color-3) l c h / 60%), oklch(from var(--ui-color-6) l c h / 5%) )

ui-critical.$description: Severity color for errors and destructive actions. A red at hue 25 by default.

ui-critical-text.$description: Critical as a text color: the `.ui-critical` items of a `Menu`, a `.ui-critical` `Button` with no variant or `.ui-outlined`, and `del` and `.ui-del` text. `--ui-critical` with its lightness limited so it reads as text on every surface.
ui-critical-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-critical) min(l, var(--_ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-critical) max(l, var(--_ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-info.$description: Severity color for informational messages, and the dotted underline of `abbr`, `dfn`, `.ui-abbr` and `.ui-dfn`. A blue at hue 240 by default, the same blue as the `.ui-info` palette.

ui-info-text.$description: Info as a text color, for informational text outside an `.ui-info` scope. `--ui-info` with its lightness limited so it reads as text on every surface.
ui-info-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-info) min(l, var(--_ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-info) max(l, var(--_ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-invalid.$description: Color for invalid field borders, fills and outlines. Lighter in dark mode with more contrast, so invalid borders stand out from the page.
ui-invalid.$value: light-dark( var(--ui-critical), oklch( from var(--ui-critical) max(l, var(--_ui-invalid-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-accent-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-invalid-text.$description: Color for validation messages and invalid labels. `--ui-invalid` with its lightness limited so it reads as text on every surface, so it stays readable where `--ui-invalid` is lighter for borders.
ui-invalid-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-invalid) min(l, var(--_ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-invalid) max(l, var(--_ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-neutral.$description: Severity color for neutral messages. `--ui-gray-hue` and `--ui-gray-chroma` at `0.53`, the lightness of `--ui-gray-9`, darker in light mode with more contrast. The `.ui-neutral` scope derives its palette from its hue and chroma.
ui-neutral.$value: light-dark( oklch( min(0.53, var(--_ui-accent-max-lightness)) var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) ), oklch(0.53 var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue)) )

ui-neutral-text.$description: Neutral as a text color, for neutral text outside an `.ui-neutral` scope. `--ui-neutral` with its lightness limited so it reads as text on every surface.
ui-neutral-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-neutral) min(l, var(--_ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-neutral) max(l, var(--_ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-success.$description: Severity color for success messages. A green at hue 145 by default.

ui-success-text.$description: Success as a text color, for success text outside an `.ui-success` scope, and `ins` and `.ui-ins` text. `--ui-success` with its lightness limited so it reads as text on every surface.
ui-success-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-success) min(l, var(--_ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-success) max(l, var(--_ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-warning.$description: Severity color for warnings, an orange at hue 75 by default. Unlike the other severities it keeps its lightness with more contrast: the fill is light and takes dark `--ui-on-warning` text, and `--ui-warning-text` gets the stricter lightness limits instead.

ui-on-warning.$description: Text color on a `--ui-warning` fill: the warning `Badge`. White on a warning below 0.182 relative luminance and near-black above it, like `--ui-on-primary`.

ui-warning-text.$description: Warning as a text color, for warning text outside a `.ui-warning` scope. `--ui-warning` with its lightness limited so it reads as text on every surface.
ui-warning-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-warning) min(l, var(--_ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-warning) max(l, var(--_ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-critical-fill.$description: Critical as a fill under `--ui-on-fill` text: `--ui-critical` with its lightness capped so the text reads on it, darker with more contrast. Critical `Button`s and `ControlGroup` dividers, and the critical `Badge`. A theme that pins its critical fill sets it here.
ui-critical-fill.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-critical) min(l, var(--_ui-accent-fill-max-lightness)) c h )

ui-info-fill.$description: Info as a fill under `--ui-on-fill` text: `--ui-info` with its lightness capped so the text reads on it, darker with more contrast. Critical `Button`s and `ControlGroup` dividers, and the info `Badge`. A theme that pins its info fill sets it here.
ui-info-fill.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-info) min(l, var(--_ui-accent-fill-max-lightness)) c h )

ui-neutral-fill.$description: Neutral as a fill under `--ui-on-fill` text: `--ui-neutral` with its lightness capped so the text reads on it, darker with more contrast. Critical `Button`s and `ControlGroup` dividers, and the neutral `Badge`. A theme that pins its neutral fill sets it here.
ui-neutral-fill.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-neutral) min(l, var(--_ui-accent-fill-max-lightness)) c h )

ui-success-fill.$description: Success as a fill under `--ui-on-fill` text: `--ui-success` with its lightness capped so the text reads on it, darker with more contrast. Critical `Button`s and `ControlGroup` dividers, and the success `Badge`. A theme that pins its success fill sets it here.
ui-success-fill.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-success) min(l, var(--_ui-accent-fill-max-lightness)) c h )

ui-primary-source.$description: The brand color `--ui-primary` is derived from, within the lightness range more contrast narrows. Set it to a theme's brand color so more contrast can darken or lighten it while keeping its hue. Setting `--ui-primary` directly pins the color in every contrast mode.
ui-primary-source.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 0.499 min(0.191, calc(0.382 * (c / 0.21))) h ), var(--ui-color-6) )

ui-primary.$description: Brand color for primary actions and accents. Derived from `--ui-primary-source` within the lightness range more contrast narrows. Set `--ui-primary-source` to keep more contrast working, or this token to pin the color.
ui-primary.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-primary-source) min(l, var(--_ui-primary-max-lightness)) c h ), oklch( from var(--ui-primary-source) max(l, var(--_ui-primary-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-accent-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-on-primary.$description: Text color on `--ui-primary`. Derived with relative color from the primary's relative luminance (the `y` of `xyz-d65`): white on a primary below 0.182, near-black above it, so either side keeps 4.5:1 and a custom `--ui-primary` gets readable text.

ui-primary-text.$description: Primary as a text color: links, rich text links, `Callout` link hover, `Button` and `ControlGroup` with `.ui-primary` and no variant or `.ui-outlined`. Defaults to `--ui-primary` with its lightness limited so it reads as text on every surface, and is derived again from the more-contrast primary. Set it when the primary needs another shade for text.
ui-primary-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-primary) min(l, var(--_ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-primary) max(l, var(--_ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--_ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-link-visited-text-color.$description: Text and underline color of a visited `.ui-link` and of visited links in `.ui-rich-text`. Hover and focus keep their own color. When unset, visited links look like the others.

ui-primary-tonal.$description: Background of `Button` and `ControlGroup` with `.ui-primary` and `.ui-tonal`, and of a tonal `Avatar`. When unset, they use `--ui-palette-tonal`. Material's `primary-container` and shadcn's `secondary` go here.

ui-on-primary-tonal.$description: Text color on `--ui-primary-tonal`. Set it with `--ui-primary-tonal`.

ui-selected-strong.$description: Mark of a selected item that has to stand out from the page on its own: the current `Carousel` marker, the bar on the start edge of a selected `List` row, the selected tab of filled `Tabs`, the current `Stepper` and `Timeline` markers, the border of a checked `Message` reaction, and the done part of a `Progress` bar, a `Stepper` and a tracked `Timeline`. Defaults to `--ui-primary`. `--ui-selected` is the fill behind a selected item and may be faint.

ui-on-selected-strong.$description: Text color on `--ui-selected-strong`: the selected tab of filled `Tabs` and the number or icon of the current `Stepper` and `Timeline` markers. Defaults to `--ui-on-primary`.

ui-text-strong.$description: Strongest text color, for headings, labels and values. Body text is `--ui-text`.

ui-text.$description: Body text color. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-text-strength-light` or `--ui-text-strength-dark`.
ui-text.$value: light-dark( color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-text-strength-light), var(--ui-surface) ), color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-text-strength-dark), var(--ui-surface) ) )

ui-text-subtle.$description: Secondary text: placeholders, field helper text, overlines, descriptions in `List` and `Menu` items, unselected `Tabs` labels and `Table` captions. `--ui-text` unless a theme sets it.

ui-text-disabled.$description: Text color of disabled buttons and chips. `--ui-text` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-text-disabled-strength`. Also the label and border of an unchecked disabled `ToggleButton`.
ui-text-disabled.$value: color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text) var(--ui-text-disabled-strength), var(--ui-surface) )

ui-on-fill.$description: Text on an intent fill: `--ui-critical-fill`, `--ui-info-fill`, `--ui-neutral-fill` and `--ui-success-fill` for critical `Button`s and the critical, info, neutral and success `Badge`, and `--ui-choice-checked-accent` and `--ui-choice-invalid-accent` for the checked and invalid choice marks. Near-white in both modes. Not `--ui-palette-on-strong`, which turns dark in dark mode for the light `--ui-palette-strong`.

ui-surface-raised.$description: Background of elevated cards and accordions, dialogs, drawers, menus and native select options.

ui-surface-filled.$description: Background of filled areas: lists, `.ui-filled` progress and range tracks, table headers and footers, and hovered table rows.

ui-surface-inverse.$description: Background of `Tooltip`, the `Carousel` buttons and `kbd`, `var`, `.ui-kbd` and `.ui-var`, inverted against the page.

ui-surface-tonal-hover.$description: Hover fill of a `--ui-surface-tonal` surface: clickable `Chip`s, a filled `Field` and tonal `Button`s with `--ui-button-hover: shade-all`. Derived from `--ui-surface-tonal`, darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode.
ui-surface-tonal-hover.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-surface-tonal) calc(l * 0.93) c h), oklch(from var(--ui-surface-tonal) calc(l * 1.1) c h) )

ui-surface-image.$description: An image, such as a gradient, painted over `--ui-surface` on the page (`html`). `none` when unset. It spans the whole page and scrolls with it, so give gradient stops a length to keep a glow at the top. Contrast checks measure text against `--ui-surface`, so keep the image close to it.

ui-surface-raised-image.$description: An image, such as a gradient, painted over `--ui-surface-raised` on elevated cards and accordions, dialogs, drawers, menus and the select picker. `none` when unset. Contrast checks measure text against `--ui-surface-raised`, so keep the image close to it.

ui-border-width.$description: Default border width for components that draw a border.

ui-border-width-large.$description: Width of emphasized rules: the head and foot rules of rich text tables, the `AvatarGroup` ring, the `Badge` border, the neutral `Chip` dot, the dotted `DescriptionList` rule, the `Tabs` indicator, the bar on a selected `List` row, the `Spinner` ring, and at one and a half times, the blockquote bar.

ui-radius.$description: Corner radius for every component: cards, callouts, menus, buttons and fields follow it, and small parts like `kbd`, tooltips and checkboxes never get rounder than it. Set it to `0` for square corners. Takes a single length.

ui-radius-round.$description: The pill radius for round buttons, avatars, badges, the chip dot, radios, switches, the range track and the carousel buttons and markers.

ui-chip-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Chip`. When unset, chips follow `--ui-radius`.

ui-dialog-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Dialog`. When unset, dialogs follow `--ui-radius`.

ui-menu-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Menu` and the select picker. When unset, menus follow `--ui-radius` and the picker `--ui-field-radius`, like its field.

ui-radius-large.$description: Largest step of the radius scale, for your own large surfaces that want more rounding than controls. `--ui-radius` times 1.5, so `0` still squares it. No component reads it.

ui-radius-small.$description: Corner radius of small parts: `kbd`, inline `code`, `mark`, `var`, `Tooltip`, the file input and a `rounded` `Avatar`. `--ui-radius`, capped at 5px.

ui-radius-x-small.$description: Corner radius of the `Checkbox` box. `--ui-radius`, capped at 2px.

ui-border-color.$description: Default border color for cards, lists, tables and dividers, on the page and inside every raised or filled surface. `--ui-text-strong` at `--ui-border-strength-light` or `--ui-border-strength-dark` over transparent, so it reads the same on every surface.
ui-border-color.$value: light-dark( color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-border-strength-light), transparent ), color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-border-strength-dark), transparent ) )

ui-border-color-raised.$description: The edge of every raised surface: tonal and elevated `Card`, `Accordion` and `Dialog`, tonal `Callout` without a severity, `Drawer`, `Menu` and the select picker. Set it to outline them all at once, or to `transparent` to drop their edges. When unset, each keeps its own edge: cards, accordions and dialogs the page background, so they stay visible on tonal surfaces, callouts their tonal background, and drawers, menus and the picker `--ui-border-color`. The borders inside a raised surface are `--ui-border-color`.

ui-field-radius.$description: Corner radius for fields. When unset, they follow `--ui-radius`, also where it's set on a part of the page.

ui-field-bg-color.$description: Background of a `Field` around a text input, select or textarea. When unset, `--ui-surface`, the page color.

ui-field-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding inside a `Field` around a text input, select or textarea. When unset, `--ui-space-2`. `.ui-large` reads `--ui-field-padding-inline-large`.

ui-field-padding-inline-large.$description: Horizontal padding inside a `Field` with `.ui-large`, around a text input, select or textarea. When unset, `--ui-space-4`.

ui-field-placeholder-text-color.$description: Color of placeholder text in fields. When unset, `--ui-text-subtle`.

ui-field-shadow.$description: Shadow of a `Field` around a text input, select or textarea. When unset, it follows `--ui-shadow-control`. Set it to `none` to lift buttons but keep fields flat.

ui-field-helper-text-color.$description: Text color for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-helper-font-size.$description: Font size for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-helper-line-height.$description: Line height for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-label-font-weight.$description: Font weight for emphasized field labels and legends.

ui-field-border-color.$description: Border color of every empty control: a `Field` around a text input, select or textarea, the unchecked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` unless `--ui-choice-border-color` is set, the track of a range and the `Progress` outline. `--ui-text-strong` at `--ui-field-border-strength` over transparent, so it reaches 3:1 on every surface. Lighter than `--ui-border-color`, which is decorative, is a choice a theme can make.
ui-field-border-color.$value: color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-field-border-strength), transparent )

ui-focus-border-width.$description: Border width of a focused `Checkbox` and `Radio` and of a `Field` whose input, select or textarea has focus, so the focus edge thickens, like GOV.UK's 4px and Material 3's 2dp outlined fields. Never thinner than `--ui-choice-border-width` or `--ui-field-border-width`, and the extra width grows inward, so the check, the dot and the text keep their place. Forced colors keep the wider border. When wider than the ring, it is also the bar under a highlighted link, with `--ui-link-focus` set to `highlight`. When unset, the border keeps its width.

ui-focus-ring-offset.$description: Distance between a control and its focus ring.

ui-focus-ring-style.$description: Outline style of the focus ring.

ui-focus-ring-width.$description: Width of the focus ring. `3px` with more contrast.

ui-focus-border-color.$description: Border color of a focused `Button`, `Checkbox`, `Chip`, `Radio`, `Switch` and `ToggleButton`, of a `Field` whose input, select or textarea has focus, and of a checkbox or radio card and a `Card` with a focused card link. It gives the focus ring a second color to sit on, like a dark edge under a bright ring, so pair it with `--ui-focus-ring-offset: 0px`. When set, the focus ring promises its contrast against this border instead of the page. Links and buttons that highlight, with `--ui-link-focus` or `--ui-button-focus` set to `highlight`, show neither the ring nor this border: `--ui-on-focus-highlight` carries their contrast. When unset, each keeps its own border. Forced colors ignore it.

ui-focus-ring-color.$description: Color of the keyboard focus ring. Black on surfaces lighter than OKLCH 0.6 and white on darker ones, so it reaches 3:1 on any `--ui-surface`.

ui-focus-ring-inset.$description: Negative offset for focus rings drawn inside a control, such as `List` items and select options.

ui-focus-highlight.$description: Fill of a focused link or button that highlights instead of showing the ring, when `--ui-link-focus` or `--ui-button-focus` is `highlight`: `--ui-focus-ring-color` made opaque. A translucent ring, like Bootstrap's, fills at full strength, since text contrast on a see-through fill depends on what is behind it.

ui-on-focus-highlight.$description: Text color on `--ui-focus-highlight`, and the bar under a highlighted link: black or white, whichever reads on it. It switches at OKLCH lightness 0.57, where black and white both reach 4.5:1 on a gray, since it colors text; the focus ring switches at 0.6, which only needs 3:1. Set it to match a brand's focus text, and hand it back under more contrast with the ring color.

ui-font-family-body.$description: Font family for body text, fields and buttons. `system-ui, sans-serif` by default.

ui-font-family-code.$description: Font family for `code`, `kbd`, `samp` and `pre` in rich text, `.ui-kbd`, `.ui-samp`, `.ui-var`, code blocks and `kbd` in buttons and lists. A monospace stack by default.
ui-font-family-code.$value: Dank Mono, Operator Mono, Inconsolata, Fira Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, Monaco, Droid Sans Mono, Source Code Pro, Cascadia Code, Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

ui-font-family-heading.$description: Font family for `h1`–`h6` and the `.ui-h1`–`.ui-h6` classes. When unset, headings follow `--ui-font-family-body`.

ui-font-size-100.$description: The smallest step of the type scale, 12px. `--ui-font-size-caption` reads it. Set the steps to reshape every size at once, or a type token such as `--ui-font-size-body` to move one.

ui-font-size-300.$description: Type scale step, 16px. `--ui-font-size-body`, `--ui-font-size-control` and `--ui-font-size-h6` read it.

ui-font-size-400.$description: Type scale step, 18px. `--ui-font-size-h5` reads it, and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows from it.

ui-font-size-500.$description: Type scale step, 20px. `--ui-font-size-large` reads it, `--ui-font-size-h3` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows to it.

ui-font-size-600.$description: Type scale step, 24px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h3` grows to it.

ui-font-size-700.$description: Type scale step, 32px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows from it.

ui-font-size-800.$description: Type scale step, 40px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows to it.

ui-font-size-900.$description: The largest step of the type scale, 56px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows to it.

ui-fluid-min-inline-size.$description: Viewport inline size where `--ui-fluid-progress` starts at 0 and the fluid heading sizes at their minimum, 20rem.

ui-fluid-max-inline-size.$description: Viewport inline size where `--ui-fluid-progress` reaches 1 and the fluid heading sizes their maximum, 48rem.

ui-font-weight-body.$description: Font weight for body text, `List` text and `Button` keyboard shortcuts.

ui-font-weight-emphasis.$description: Font weight for badges, overlines and group labels.

ui-font-weight-label.$description: Font weight for labels, table headers and titles.

ui-font-weight-heading.$description: Font weight for headings, buttons and terms.

ui-letter-spacing-caps.$description: Letter spacing of uppercase text: overlines and the first paragraph of an `hgroup`.

ui-letter-spacing-display.$description: Letter spacing of `h1` and `h2`, tighter than the body.

ui-letter-spacing-heading.$description: Letter spacing of `h3` and `h4`, slightly tighter than the body.

ui-line-height-tight.$description: Line height of single-line controls and dense text: field inputs, dense `Table` cells, the `Stat` value, `Tooltip`, `Card` captions and keyboard hints in buttons.

ui-line-height-compact.$description: Line height of short text that isn't page prose: `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` labels, field start and end text, form descriptions, captions, the lead paragraph, `List` text, the `Stat` label and description and the `Stepper` description. Page text uses `--ui-line-height-body`.

ui-line-height-body.$description: Line height of the page text set on `html`, and of `Tabs` labels.

ui-rich-text-line-height.$description: Line height of `.ui-rich-text`, for themes whose prose is looser than their interface text. When unset, rich text keeps the line height around it, `--ui-line-height-body` on the page.

ui-rhythm-step.$description: Vertical rhythm unit. Rich text margins and heading line heights round to it.

ui-rich-text-flow-gap.$description: Space between paragraphs, lists, blockquotes, tables, `details` and `address` in `.ui-rich-text`, rounded to `--ui-rhythm-step`. Headings, code blocks, figures and `hr` take multiples of it, with more room above headings than below. When unset, `1.25em` of the rich text font size.

ui-rich-text-heading-margin-block-start.$description: Space above `h1` to `h6` in `.ui-rich-text`, rounded to `--ui-rhythm-step`. It overlaps the margin of the block before, so `0px` leaves the paragraph gap. Give a length: a unitless `0` drops both margins. `em` is the heading's own font size, so larger headings get more room, and `rem` gives every level the same space. When unset, each level takes a multiple of `--ui-rich-text-flow-gap`: 3 above `h1` and `h2`, 2 above `h3` and 1.5 above `h4` to `h6`. A heading group keeps its own spacing.

ui-rich-text-heading-margin-block-end.$description: Space below `h1` to `h6` in `.ui-rich-text`, rounded to `--ui-rhythm-step`. `em` is the heading's own font size, so larger headings get more room, and `rem` gives every level the same space. When unset, each level takes a multiple of `--ui-rich-text-flow-gap`: 1 under `h1`, 0.75 under `h2` and 0.5 under `h3` to `h6`. A heading group keeps its own spacing.

ui-underline-offset.$description: Gap between text and its underline for `Link`, rich text links and `Stepper` links.

ui-underline-offset-small.$description: Gap between text and the underline of `abbr`, `dfn`, `ins` and `u` and their classes.

ui-underline-hover-thickness.$description: Underline thickness of `Link` and rich text links on hover and keyboard focus. At rest they keep the font's own thickness.

ui-link-focus.$description: How a focused `.ui-link` and a focused link in `.ui-rich-text` show focus. `highlight` fills the link with `--ui-focus-highlight`, draws its text and a bar under it in `--ui-on-focus-highlight` and drops the underline, like GOV.UK. The bar is a block-end border as thick as the focus ring or `--ui-focus-border-width`, whichever is wider, so it follows the writing mode and sits under every line of a wrapped link. The outline stays, transparent, so forced colors still draw the ring. When unset (`ring`), the focus ring shows.

ui-link-font-weight.$description: Font weight of `.ui-link` and of links in `.ui-rich-text`. When unset, links follow `--ui-font-weight-heading`, the weight of headings.

ui-font-size-caption.$description: Font size of captions, `Badge`, `Chip`, `Divider` labels, `List` secondary text, `Menu` shortcuts, overlines, `small`, `figcaption` and x-small buttons, toggles and fields. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-100`.

ui-font-size-small.$description: Font size of helper text, `Callout`, `Table`, `Tooltip`, code blocks, `List` text, small buttons, toggles and fields, and large chips. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-200`.

ui-font-size-body.$description: Font size of body copy, `Card` text and the `Callout` title. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-size-control.$description: Font size of the default `Button`, `Field`, `Tabs` and `ToggleButton`. Small and x-small sizes read `--ui-font-size-small` and `--ui-font-size-caption`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-size-large.$description: Font size of lead paragraphs, `.ui-p.ui-large`, large `Avatar` initials, the `DescriptionList` total row, the value of a small `Stat` and the `OneTimeCode` digits. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-500`.

ui-fluid-progress.$description: Position of the viewport inline size in the `--ui-fluid-min-inline-size` to `--ui-fluid-max-inline-size` window, 0 to 1, from `progress()`. `--ui-font-size-h1` to `--ui-font-size-h4` grow with it, and a theme can ramp other values on the same window.

ui-font-size-h1.$description: Font size for `h1` and `.ui-h1`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-700` to `--ui-font-size-900` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h2.$description: Font size for `h2` and `.ui-h2`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-600` to `--ui-font-size-800` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h3.$description: Font size for `h3` and `.ui-h3`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-500` to `--ui-font-size-600` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h4.$description: Font size for `h4` and `.ui-h4`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-400` to `--ui-font-size-500` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h5.$description: Font size for `h5` and `.ui-h5`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-400`.

ui-font-size-h6.$description: Font size for `h6` and `.ui-h6`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-code-bg-color.$description: Background of inline `code` in rich text and `Typography`. `--ui-text` at `--ui-code-bg-alpha-light` in light mode and `--ui-code-bg-alpha-dark` in dark mode, fainter with more contrast so the text stands out.
ui-code-bg-color.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-text) l c h / var(--ui-code-bg-alpha-light)), oklch(from var(--ui-text) l c h / var(--ui-code-bg-alpha-dark)) )

ui-code-block-bg-color.$description: Background of `pre.ui-code-block` and `pre` in rich text. `--ui-surface-inverse` in light mode and `--ui-surface-filled` in dark mode, so the block is dark in both.

ui-code-block-text-color.$description: Text color of `pre.ui-code-block` and `pre` in rich text. `--ui-on-inverse` in light mode and `--ui-text-strong` in dark mode, on `--ui-code-block-bg-color`.

ui-space-scale.$description: Multiplier for the `--ui-space-*` scale, the gaps, padding and margins of containers such as cards, dialogs, forms and tables, and the padding and gaps of rich text. Controls follow `--ui-density` instead. See [Spacing](/guide/theming#spacing).

ui-card-padding.$description: Padding of `Card`, `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Accordion` content, headers, footers and actions, and of `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` cards. When unset, `--ui-space-4`. Card and accordion actions set it to their own inline padding, which caps how far a text button at either end pulls itself out.

ui-list-item-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding of `List` and `Menu` items, headings and select options. When unset, `--ui-space-4`.

ui-space-1.$description: Spacing step 1, 0.25rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-space-2.$description: Spacing step 2, 0.5rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-space-3.$description: Spacing step 3, 0.75rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-space-4.$description: Spacing step 4, 1rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-space-5.$description: Spacing step 5, 1.25rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-space-6.$description: Spacing step 6, 1.5rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-space-7.$description: Spacing step 7, 1.75rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-space-8.$description: Spacing step 8, 2rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-space-12.$description: Spacing step 12, 3rem times `--ui-space-scale`: a step's number is its size in quarter rems.

ui-control-accent.$description: The accent every control shares: `Button` and `ControlGroup` without `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`, a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`, and the thumb and fill of a range. Unset by default, so buttons keep `--ui-palette-strong` and choice controls `--ui-primary`. Set it to `--ui-primary` to give every control the brand color in one line, like Material and shadcn, and `--ui-button-accent` or `--ui-choice-accent` to override one of them.

ui-control-border-color.$description: Border color of controls without a fill: `Button` with `.ui-outlined`, also in an outlined `ControlGroup`, `ToggleButton`, `ToggleGroup`, `Chip` with `.ui-outlined`, the track of `Tabs` with `.ui-outlined`, and the selected `Tabs` pill. When unset, outlined buttons use their color, the selected `Tabs` pill `--ui-field-border-color` and the rest `--ui-border-color`. Themes that outline controls like fields set it to `--ui-field-border-color`.

ui-control-border-color-filled.$description: Border color of controls with a fill: `Button` with `.ui-filled` or `.ui-tonal`, also in a filled or tonal `ControlGroup`, the dividers between buttons in a `ControlGroup` that isn't outlined (unset, filled groups use `currentColor` dividers, or a shade of the accent in primary and critical ones), a checked `ToggleButton`, `Chip` without `.ui-outlined` and the `Carousel` buttons. When unset, buttons have no visible border, the carousel buttons use a shade of their fill and the rest use `--ui-border-color`. Set it with `--ui-control-border-color` to outline every control.

ui-control-on-accent.$description: Text and mark color on a `--ui-control-accent` fill. Set it with `--ui-control-accent`. `--ui-button-on-accent` and `--ui-choice-on-accent` override it per component.

ui-track-bg-color.$description: The empty part of a track: the unchecked `Switch`, `Progress` and the track of a range. When unset, `Progress` uses `--ui-surface-tonal`, the range its field border and the switch `--ui-surface-tonal` (at `0.58` lightness in dark mode). `--ui-switch-track-bg-color` comes first on the switch.

ui-density.$description: Multiplier for the control sizes: `--ui-control-size*`, `--ui-chip-size*`, `--ui-choice-size*` and the `Switch` thumb and track sizes. `0.875` is compact, `1.125` is comfortable. See [Density](/guide/theming#density).

ui-target-min-size.$description: The least width and height of a control that has no text of its own: a `Button` in a field's `.ui-start` or `.ui-end`, a `Checkbox`, `Radio` or `Switch` whose label is hidden, the `Carousel` markers and the stars of an input `Rating`. `24px`, the WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target size. It follows neither `--ui-density` nor `--ui-space-scale`, so a compact density or a small spacing scale doesn't shrink it. A theme that copies a design system with smaller targets sets it lower, as `bootstrap.css`, `shadcn.css` and `brutalist.css` set `0px`. See [Density](/guide/theming#density).

ui-control-size-x-small.$description: Shared x-small height for fields and buttons.

ui-control-size-small.$description: Shared small height for fields and buttons.

ui-control-size.$description: Shared default height for fields and buttons so they line up.

ui-control-size-large.$description: Shared large height for fields and buttons.

ui-button-accent.$description: Color of `Button` and `ControlGroup` without `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`: the fill of filled buttons, the text and border of outlined and text buttons. When unset, `--ui-control-accent`, else the darkest palette color in light mode and the lightest in dark mode.

ui-button-on-accent.$description: Text color on a filled `--ui-button-accent` button. Set it with `--ui-button-accent`. When unset, `--ui-control-on-accent`, else `--ui-palette-on-strong`.

ui-button-accent-filled.$description: Fill of `Button` and `ControlGroup` with `.ui-filled` and no `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`, of hovered outlined ones unless `--ui-button-hover` is `layer`, and of hovered tonal ones when it is unset. When unset, `--ui-button-accent`, so text, outlined and filled buttons share one color.

ui-button-on-accent-filled.$description: Text color on a `--ui-button-accent-filled` fill. Set it with `--ui-button-accent-filled`. When unset, `--ui-button-on-accent`.

ui-button-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Button`, `ControlGroup`, `ToggleButton` and `ToggleGroup`. When unset, they follow `--ui-radius`, also where it's set on a part of the page.

ui-button-font-weight.$description: Font weight of `Button`. When unset, buttons follow `--ui-font-weight-heading`.

ui-button-focus.$description: How a focused `Button` and `ControlGroup` button show focus. `highlight` fills the button with `--ui-focus-highlight` and `--ui-on-focus-highlight` text instead of the ring, like GOV.UK. The outline stays, transparent, so forced colors still draw the ring, and a button with `aria-disabled="true"` keeps the ring. When unset (`ring`), the focus ring shows.

ui-button-hover.$description: How `Button` and `ControlGroup` show hover and pressed states. `layer` draws a translucent state layer: the text color over filled and tonal buttons, the accent over outlined ones, which keep their text and border. Filled, tonal, primary and critical buttons use `--ui-state-hover-alpha-accent` and `--ui-state-active-alpha-accent`, and neutral outlined buttons the light and dark alphas. `shade-all` shades the fill of every button that has one, filled and tonal: filled buttons as when unset, tonal ones with `--ui-surface-tonal-hover`, darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode, and a step further when pressed. Outlined buttons fill with the accent, as when unset. When unset (`shade`), filled buttons shade their fill and outlined and tonal buttons fill with the accent.

ui-button-hover-shadow.$description: Shadow of `Button` with `.ui-filled`, `.ui-outlined` or `.ui-tonal` on hover. When unset, it keeps `--ui-button-shadow`.

ui-button-shadow.$description: Shadow of `Button` with `.ui-filled`, `.ui-outlined` or `.ui-tonal`, and of the `Copy` confirmation. Buttons in a `ControlGroup` have none. When unset, `--ui-shadow-control`, the shadow buttons share with toggle buttons, outlined chips and fields. Set it to give buttons alone a shadow, like a pressable edge.

ui-button-hover-translate.$description: Moves `Button` with `.ui-filled`, `.ui-outlined` or `.ui-tonal` on hover, as a `translate` value. Pair it with `--ui-button-hover-shadow` to press buttons into their shadow. `none` when unset.

ui-button-padding-inline-x-small.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-x-small`. When unset, `1ex`.

ui-button-padding-inline-small.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-small`. When unset, `1.25ex`.

ui-button-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button`. When unset, `1.5ex`, which scales with the font.

ui-button-padding-inline-large.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-large`. When unset, `2.5ex`.

ui-tabs-accent.$description: Color of the selected `Tabs` label, and of the indicator with `.ui-line`. When unset, `--ui-text-strong`. Filled tabs keep `--ui-on-selected-strong`.

ui-divider-gap.$description: Block margin around a `Divider`, times `--ui-space-scale`. Cards, callouts, dialogs and drawers set it to `--ui-space-4`. A divider that is a direct child of a card has no margin, since the card's gap already spaces it.

ui-duration-fast.$description: Transition duration for hover and press feedback.

ui-duration-slow.$description: Transition duration for entering and leaving overlays: `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Menu`.

ui-ease-enter.$description: Easing for elements entering the screen: opening `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Menu`, and the `Badge`, `Progress` and `Tooltip` transitions.

ui-ease-exit.$description: Easing for elements leaving the screen: closing `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Menu`, and a dismissed toast.

ui-ease-move.$description: Easing for movement a theme may make springy: the `Tabs` indicator, the press scale, and `Menu`, the select picker, `Tooltip` and toasts as they open. Never for anything closing. When unset, each reads its own easing; a `linear()` spring with a little overshoot gives the controls some bounce.

ui-motion.$description: Motion multiplier. `0` disables transitions, `1` is normal speed. Set to `0` automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion`. See [Motion](/guide/theming#motion).

ui-state-active-scale.$description: Scale of `Button`, `ToggleButton` and button and link `Chip`s while pressed, over `--ui-duration` with `--ui-ease-move`. Unset, so pressing doesn't scale; `0.97` gives a light press. Buttons in a `ControlGroup` and toggles in a `ToggleGroup` never scale.

ui-contrast.$description: `more` tightens the contrast primitives (`--ui-text-strength-*`, `--ui-text-disabled-strength`, `--ui-border-strength-*`, `--ui-field-border-strength`, `--ui-code-bg-alpha-*`, `--ui-state-active-alpha-dark`, `--ui-state-selected-alpha-accent` and `--ui-focus-ring-width`) and the lightness and chroma limits the global color tokens are derived within, and every global token derived from them follows. Set to `more` under `prefers-contrast: more` or by `.ui-contrast-more`. Components read it in style queries for shape changes. See [Contrast](/guide/theming#contrast).

ui-border-strength-dark.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` shows through `--ui-border-color` in dark mode. `11%`, and `55%` with more contrast.

ui-border-strength-light.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` shows through `--ui-border-color` in light mode. `17%`, and `55%` with more contrast.

ui-code-bg-alpha-dark.$description: Opacity of `--ui-code-bg-color`, the inline `code` background, in dark mode. `10%`, and `6%` with more contrast.

ui-code-bg-alpha-light.$description: Opacity of `--ui-code-bg-color`, the inline `code` background, in light mode. `12%`, and `6%` with more contrast.

ui-control-accent-max-chroma-dark.$description: The most chroma a control's accent color keeps in dark mode where it colors text or a mark: `Button` text, the `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` mark and `Copy` text, whichever optional accent token sets the color. `0.1`.

ui-control-accent-min-lightness-dark.$description: The least lightness a control's accent color has in dark mode where it colors text or a mark, like `--ui-control-accent-max-chroma-dark`. `0.8`, and `0.9` with more contrast, so a dark accent from an optional accent token still reads on a dark surface.

ui-field-border-strength.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` shows through `--ui-field-border-color`. `50%`, and `70%` with more contrast.

ui-text-disabled-strength.$description: How much of `--ui-text` is mixed into `--ui-surface` for `--ui-text-disabled`. `50%`, and `60%` with more contrast.

ui-text-strength-dark.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` is mixed into `--ui-surface` for `--ui-text` in dark mode. `80%`, and `90%` with more contrast.

ui-text-strength-light.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` is mixed into `--ui-surface` for `--ui-text` in light mode. `87%`, and `90%` with more contrast.

ui-selected.$description: Background of a selected control: a checked `ToggleButton`, the selected `ToggleGroup` item, a pressed `Chip`, a selected or current `List` item and select option, and a checked `Message` reaction. When unset, `--ui-primary` on toggles, `--ui-primary` at `--ui-state-selected-alpha-accent` on list items and options, and the same mixed into `--ui-surface` on reactions. Pair it with `--ui-on-selected`.

ui-on-selected.$description: Text color on `--ui-selected`. When unset, `--ui-on-primary` on toggles, the item's own text color on list items and the selected options of a select, and `--ui-text-strong` on a checked `Message` reaction.

ui-state-active-alpha-accent.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on primary and critical buttons (on every filled and tonal button with `--ui-button-hover: layer`) and the ring of the current `Timeline` marker.

ui-state-active-alpha-dark.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on neutral buttons in dark mode. `30%`, and `20%` with more contrast so the text keeps 7:1.

ui-state-active-alpha-light.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on neutral buttons in light mode.

ui-state-hover-alpha-accent.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on primary and critical buttons (on every filled and tonal button with `--ui-button-hover: layer`), hovered `List` rows and critical `Menu` items.

ui-state-hover-alpha-dark.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on neutral buttons and `ToggleButton` in dark mode.

ui-state-hover-alpha-light.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on neutral buttons and `ToggleButton` in light mode.

ui-state-selected-alpha-accent.$description: Alpha of the tint behind selected `List` and `Menu` rows, select options and checked `Message` reactions when `--ui-selected` is unset, behind checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` cards, which tint their accent, behind the current page (`aria-current="page"`) in text, outlined and tonal buttons, and of the selected `Tabs` pill in dark mode. `15%` with more contrast, so light text keeps 7:1 in dark mode.

ui-icon-check.$description: The check that marks the current item of a `Menu`, the selected item of a listbox and select picker, and a complete `Stepper` step. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-clear.$description: The clear option of a `Rating`. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-close.$description: The close button of a `Callout`, `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Toaster` toast. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-critical.$description: The icon of a critical `Callout` and `Toaster` toast. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-decrease.$description: The icon of a `StepButton` that steps down. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-expand.$description: The `Accordion` marker, and the arrow of a select and of an input with a datalist in a `Field`. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-hide.$description: The `PasswordToggle` while the password shows. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-increase.$description: The icon of a `StepButton` that steps up. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-info.$description: The icon of an info `Callout` and `Toaster` toast. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-invalid.$description: The mark of a `Stepper` step with an error. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-next.$description: The `Carousel` buttons, pointing to the next item and turned for the previous one. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-rating.$description: A filled star of a `Rating`, drawn over `--ui-icon-rating-empty`, so the two need the same outline. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-rating-empty.$description: An empty star of a `Rating`. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-show.$description: The `PasswordToggle` while the password is hidden. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-sort.$description: The arrow of a sorted `SortableTable` column, turned for the other direction. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-success.$description: The icon of a success `Callout` and `Toaster` toast. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-warning.$description: The icon of a warning `Callout` and `Toaster` toast. An SVG image used as a mask, so only its shape counts and it takes the text color.

ui-icon-size-x-small.$description: Smallest step of the icon size scale, for your own icons in x-small controls. No component reads it.

ui-icon-size-small.$description: Icon size inside `Chip`, x-small `Avatar` and dense `List` rows, and the chevron of a select and of an input with a datalist.

ui-icon-size-large.$description: Icon size inside `Avatar`, and of an `svg` without a `width` in `normalize.css`.

ui-choice-accent.$description: Fill of a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`, and the thumb and fill of a range. When unset, `--ui-control-accent`, else `--ui-primary`, with its lightness capped in dark mode for the choice controls. Set it, or `--ui-control-accent`, to `--ui-primary` for the plain primary, like Material and shadcn.

ui-choice-on-accent.$description: Color of the mark on a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`. Set it with `--ui-choice-accent`. When unset, `--ui-control-on-accent`, else `--ui-on-primary` in light mode and near-white in dark mode.

ui-choice-border-color.$description: Border of the unchecked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` track. When unset, `--ui-field-border-color`. Set it for themes whose field border is fainter than 3:1, like shadcn, which outlines its choices with `--ui-primary` like shadcn/ui does.

ui-choice-border-width.$description: Border width of `Checkbox`, `Radio` and the `Switch` track. When unset, `--ui-field-border-width`. Set it when a design draws its choices with a different border than its fields, like Material 3's 2dp checkbox, radio and switch outlines next to its 1dp outlined fields. The check and the dot fit inside it.

ui-choice-checked.$description: How a checked `Checkbox` and `Radio` look. `mark` keeps the surface and the border of the unchecked input and draws the check, dash or dot in the choice accent, lifted to text lightness in dark mode, like GOV.UK. When unset (`fill`), the input fills with the accent under a mark in its on-accent color. Forced colors always fill. `Switch` and checkbox and radio cards don't read it.

ui-choice-label-offset.$description: Moves `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` labels down (positive) or up (negative) against their control. Use `em` or `cap` to scale with the label font.

ui-choice-ripple-bg-color.$description: Halo color for the `Checkbox` and `Radio` hover effect. `--ui-text` at 20%.

ui-choice-checked-accent.$description: The fill of a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` when no optional accent token is set: `--ui-primary`, with its lightness capped in dark mode so the mark keeps 3:1 against its surface.
ui-choice-checked-accent.$value: light-dark( var(--ui-primary), oklch( from var(--ui-primary) min(l, var(--_ui-choice-fill-max-lightness)) c h ) )

ui-choice-invalid-accent.$description: The fill of a checked invalid `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`: `--ui-invalid`, with its lightness capped in dark mode like `--ui-choice-checked-accent`.
ui-choice-invalid-accent.$value: light-dark( var(--ui-invalid), oklch( from var(--ui-invalid) min(l, var(--_ui-choice-fill-max-lightness)) c h ) )

ui-choice-size-small.$description: `Checkbox` and `Radio` input size with `.ui-small`, and in dense `List` rows unless the control has a size class.

ui-switch-thumb-size-small.$description: Diameter of the `Switch` thumb with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class.

ui-switch-track-block-size-small.$description: Height of the `Switch` track with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-x-small.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-x-small`. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-x-small` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-small.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-small` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size.$description: Width of the `Switch` track. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-large.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-large`. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-large` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-thumb-bg-color.$description: Color of the unchecked `Switch` thumb. The checked thumb uses `--ui-choice-on-accent`.

ui-switch-track-bg-color.$description: Background of the unchecked `Switch` track, ahead of `--ui-track-bg-color`. When both are unset, `--ui-surface-tonal`, at `0.58` lightness in dark mode.

ui-shadow-control.$description: Shadow of buttons with a variant (unless `--ui-button-shadow` is set), standalone `ToggleButton`, outlined `Chip` and fields. `none` by default, for themes that lift controls off the page.

ui-shadow-surface.$description: Shadow of tonal and outlined `Card` and `Accordion`, and of `Callout`. `none` by default, for themes that put every surface on the same plane.

ui-shadow-color.$description: Color of every shadow, with its base opacity. Each layer of `--ui-shadow-elevated`, `--ui-shadow-overlay`, `--ui-shadow-scroll` and `--ui-shadow-selected` adds its own opacity on top, with relative color. `oklch(0.268 0.003 265 / 1%)` in light mode and `oklch(0.11 0.01 259 / 20%)` in dark mode, also in `.ui-light` and `.ui-dark` parts of the page.

ui-shadow-elevated.$description: Shadow of elevated `Card` and `Accordion`. Five layers of `--ui-shadow-color`, which follows the color scheme, also in `.ui-light` and `.ui-dark` parts of the page.
ui-shadow-elevated.$value: 0 -1px 3px 0 oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.02)), 0 1px 2px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.02)), 0 2px 5px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.04)), 0 4px 12px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.05)), 0 12px 15px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.07))

ui-shadow-overlay.$description: Shadow of layers that float above the page: `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Menu`, select pickers and the `Carousel` buttons. Five layers of `--ui-shadow-color`.

ui-shadow-scroll.$description: Shadow under the header and above the footer of a scrolled `Dialog` or `Drawer`, and under a sticky `Table` header. Six layers of `--ui-shadow-color`.
ui-shadow-scroll.$value: 0 -2px 5px 0 oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.02)), 0 1px 1px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.03)), 0 2px 2px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.03)), 0 5px 5px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.04)), 0 9px 9px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.05)), 0 16px 16px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.06))

ui-shadow-selected.$description: Shadow of the selected tab in default and `.ui-filled` `Tabs`. `.ui-line` and `.ui-outlined` have none. One layer of `--ui-shadow-color`.
ui-shadow-selected.$value: 0 1px 2px -1px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.09))

ui-backdrop-blur.$description: Blur radius behind an open `Dialog` or `Drawer`.

ui-backdrop-bg-color.$description: Overlay color behind an open `Dialog` or `Drawer`. `--ui-text` at 50% in light mode, and half the lightness of `--ui-surface` at 50% in dark mode.
ui-backdrop-bg-color.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-text) l c h / 50%), oklch(from var(--ui-surface) calc(l / 2) c h / 50%) )

ui-safe-area-inset-block-start.$description: The part of the top of the screen a notch or a status bar covers, `env(safe-area-inset-top)`. A `Drawer` at the block start or on an inline side pads its content below it, and a `Toaster` at the block start sits below it. `0px` unless the viewport meta tag has `viewport-fit=cover`.

ui-safe-area-inset-block-end.$description: The part of the bottom of the screen a home indicator covers, `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`. A `Drawer` at the block end or on an inline side pads its content above it, and a `Toaster` at the block end sits above it. `0px` unless the viewport meta tag has `viewport-fit=cover`.

ui-safe-area-inset-inline-start.$description: The part of the inline start side a notch or a rounded corner covers, as on a phone held sideways: `env(safe-area-inset-left)`, and `env(safe-area-inset-right)` on a right-to-left page. A `Drawer` on that side or at the block start or end pads its content clear of it, and a `Toaster` keeps its toasts clear of it. `0px` unless the viewport meta tag has `viewport-fit=cover`.

ui-safe-area-inset-inline-end.$description: The part of the inline end side a notch or a rounded corner covers, as on a phone held sideways: `env(safe-area-inset-right)`, and `env(safe-area-inset-left)` on a right-to-left page. A `Drawer` on that side or at the block start or end pads its content clear of it, and a `Toaster` keeps its toasts clear of it. `0px` unless the viewport meta tag has `viewport-fit=cover`.

ui-anchor-position-area.$description: The `position-area` of the floating content of an `Anchor`, a popover `Menu` or a `Tooltip`. The `positionArea` prop sets it on one instance, or set it on an element for everything inside it. When unset, each keeps its own: `self-start self-end` for `Anchor`, its `side` and `span` for `Menu` (`self-block-end span-self-inline-end`), `self-block-start` for `Tooltip` and `self-inline-start` for the `Copy` label.
